checks.summary: The task has bounded, non-overlapping ownership, explicit clean-room exclusions, a reversible local-only delivery boundary, and an approved Mobbin exception.
Direct-route code splitting and isolation from SiteBoot are specific and verifiable while preserving the ordinary portfolio boot path.
Valid local PNG/JPEG decode, browser-memory handling, generic unbranded geometry, and copied-asset exclusions are explicit.
Background, padding, scale, and x/y controls define one bounded deterministic composition.
PNG dimensions and preview/export visual parity are observable and included in the demo evidence contract.
Unsupported, corrupt, and zero-dimension negative paths require recoverable errors and preservation of the last valid composition.
Build, lint, privacy, focus, labeling, and existing-portfolio checks are concrete and mapped to evidence.
The repository defines the frozen pnpm lint command and the task reserves a concrete log path.
The repository defines the frozen production build command and the task reserves a concrete log path.
The diff hygiene command is valid and scoped review evidence is required before completion.
The demo covers direct navigation, import, every composition control, export, visual comparison, and console state.
The negative test covers unsupported, corrupt, and zero-dimension input with recoverability.
Network and storage inspection before and after import/export can verify that image bytes and editor state remain local and ephemeral.
The installed icon system, semantic resolver, neutral unknown-key fallback, and diagnostic behavior are frozen and testable.
Keyboard traversal, visible focus, accessible names, and consistent icon geometry are explicitly required.
Frontend risk is bounded by route isolation, code splitting, desktop-only scope, visual verification, and preservation of the existing portfolio path.
The task forbids transmission and persistence and includes direct browser network and storage verification.
